title: Ingress Anomaly Map
summary: An interactive map of every recorded Ingress anomaly outcome worldwide.
tagline: Explore the recorded history of Ingress anomalies worldwide.
description: Browse recorded Ingress anomaly sites and results on an interactive world map, with filters for series and country.

features.title: Faction outcomes
features.description: Colour sites by faction outcome and size them according to recency.

features.title: Series and country filters
features.description: Select several anomaly series or countries, with optional automatic framing of the selected sites.

features.title: Complete site history
features.description: Open a site to see every recorded event and score at that location.

features.title: Maintained dataset
features.description: Add new anomaly results to the curated and geocoded dataset after each series.

origin.title: Collected history becomes more useful on a map.
origin.body: I saw that historical anomaly results had already been collected by the community. From earlier work with geospatial data, I knew a map could make the data easier to understand and reveal how faction performance varied by city, country and time. The results come from Ingress Anomaly Stats, originally collated by Breezy, and I add new results as each anomaly finishes.
